parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, no documented border or facility restrictions on visitors, and courts demonstrably work for trans people (2007 self-ID ruling; July 2024 order removing medical verification). Resident-side LGR gaps and conversion therapy are climate signals only. Weight falls on documented societal hostility: discrimination in public spaces and frequent physical/sexual harassment of visibly trans people (Nov 2024), deep stigma, and a sharply worsening political climate — the head of government's April 2026 homophobic video plus supporters' death threats. That is tier-3 hostility with real but uneven recourse, not state-directed targeting; no trans killing rate or universal state-imposed exposure appears. Functioning protective institutions plus absence of traveller-facing restriction keep this in Reduced Risk despite the rising hate-speech climate.
